title: PYSEC-2025-19
summary: Affected: PyPI: picklescan picklescan before 0.0.22 only considers standard pickle file extensions in the scope for its vulnerability scan. An attacker could craft a malicious model that uses Pickle and include a malicious pickle file with a non-standard file extension. Because the malicious pickle file inclusion is not considered as part of the scope of picklescan, the file would pass security checks and appear to be safe, when it could instead prove to be problematic.

title: PYSEC-2024-115
summary: Affected: PyPI: langchain-community A vulnerability in the GraphCypherQAChain class of langchain-ai/langchain-community version 0.2.5 allows for SQL injection through prompt injection. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data manipulation, data exfiltration, denial of service (DoS) by deleting all data, breaches in multi-tenant security environments, and data integrity issues. Attackers can create, update, or delete nodes and relationships without proper authorization, extract sensitive data, disrupt services, access data across different tenants, and compromise the integrity of the database.

title: CVE-2026-129261 — Kingston FURY CTRL RGB Control Software IOCTL NTIOLib_X64.sys exposed ioctl with insufficient access control
summary: Affected: Kingston FURY CTRL RGB Control Software A vulnerability was found in Kingston FURY CTRL RGB Control Software up to 2.0.66.0. The impacted element is an unknown function in the library NTIOLib_X64.sys of the component IOCTL Handler. Performing a manipulation results in exposed ioctl with insufficient access control. The attack is only possible with local access.

title: CVE-2026-129260 — Mereithhh VanBlog Custom local.provider.ts fs.readFileSync path traversal
summary: Affected: Mereithhh VanBlog A security vulnerability has been detected in Mereithhh VanBlog up to 0.54.0. This vulnerability affects the function fs.readFileSync of the file local.provider.ts of the component Custom Page Handler. The manipulation of the argument path leads to path traversal. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version test-20261013 is able to resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is d63aa163f10b6dc1080e2368fe8e71aa95b765cb. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

title: CVE-2026-127115 — BuddyForms <= 2.10.6 - Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'title' Attribute of [bf_login_form] Shortcode
summary: Affected: themekraft BuddyForms The BuddyForms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'buddyforms_form_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.10.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable when a form configured with the public_submit option is published — a condition met by the plugin's bundled Post Simple template out of the box.

title: CVE-2026-120687 — Lightbox & Modal Popup WordPress Plugin <= 2.8.7 - Unauthenticated Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via Image Alt…
summary: Affected: fooplugins Lightbox & Modal Popup WordPress Plugin – FooBox The Lightbox & Modal Popup WordPress Plugin – FooBox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'img alt attribute inside .wp-caption container' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable by Subscriber-level users when bbPress is installed, as its bbp_filter_kses filter chain permits img and pre tags while preserving numeric character references inside attribute values, allowing encoded payloads to bypass save-time sanitization and reach the vulnerable sink fully intact. Exploitation by attackers with subscriber-level access and above requires that bbPress 2.6.20 is installed, a public forum exists, and either the first topic has already been approved or subsequent topics clear moderation. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with contributor-level access and above.

title: CVE-2026-116753 — Multi Step for Contact Form 7 <= 2.9.1 - Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Multipart Field Name
summary: Affected: ninjateam Multi Step for Contact Form 7 The Multi Step for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'multipart field name (array key)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires the target CF7 form to have the 'Save every step' option enabled and the Database for Contact Form 7 companion plugin to be active with its 'Expandable' table option enabled, both of which are disabled by default.

title: CVE-2026-110531 — FV Player 8 <= 8.1.9 - Authenticated (Subscriber+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'Popup' Shortcode Attribute via Prof…
summary: Affected: foliovision FV Player 8 The FV Player 8 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'fv_player_videos' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.1.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the administrator-controlled "Allow visitors to upload videos to their profile" setting to be enabled, without which the vulnerable save routine is inaccessible to Subscriber-level users.

title: GHSA-wxr2-fxvm-rgwm
summary: A vulnerability was identified in Tenda AC18 15.03.05.05_multi/15.03.05.19 Build 6318. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /cgi-bin/upgrade of the component Firmware Upgrade Handler. Such manipulation of the argument upgradeFile leads to insufficient verification of data authenticity. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

title: GHSA-pgpf-hp23-r4gp
summary: A weakness has been identified in Mereithhh VanBlog up to 0.54.0. This affects an unknown part of the file packages/server/src/types/access/access.ts of the component Image Upload Endpoint. Executing a manipulation can lead to cross site scripting. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
